_comment: First HSC-exam year of the CURRENT Stage 6 syllabus, per subject. Exam papers with year < cutoff are old-syllabus and get filed under Archive-pre-<cutoff>/. Subjects with no entry are treated as all-current (nothing archived). Only edit when NSW actually introduces a new syllabus; then re-run tools/organize_papers.py. These 16 are the high-confidence, high-volume subjects; language/VET cutoffs still need authoritative implementation years before being added.
